title: Get PDF Artifact Editor Working End to End
description: Get pdf artifact editor working end to end. In parallel the shared work fleet mechanism is being developed; if it doesn't work fall back to native tools. Coordinate with Opus, dispatch Sonnet agents for implementation and Haiku agents for exploration/audits. Fix fundamental unrelated issues found along the way. Treat the goal end to end.
summary: Round 4 (see 🌐️pdf-browser-journey.md, "End-to-end verification, round 4"): wasm build made reliable within memory (root cause -Z threads=0 parallel front end; hub crate 10.0 GB + SIGKILLed component before, 5.9/8.8 GB and linked after with threads=1 target override; FIFO cargo gate; quiet-tree waiter). Incremental Save cause corrected: MediaIn already fills custody (new native law through the real PluginRuntime passes); the PDF 1.7 editor never declared its artifact:native output port so the shell used the compact reference route — fixed (declare_native_save + law), then the native Save failed on a stale revision while the keep/attach archive load was still running — fixed by draining the attachment lane before Save. Shell: guest UI patch rejections now surface as a typed, localized boot/render error with code, rule and node (rejection.ts + fixture/schema/feature bun tests); refreshes no longer adopt and throw action refusals, so range and unknown-field notices are localized and announced. Final journey 18/24 (was 14/22); open: strip bound to the host instance after Open File, opened-file Save still compact in the browser after keep/reload.
